positions.name: AsyncJobContractForRemember
positions.frame: What is the operational contract for remember — how do immediate receipt, polling cursor, and dispatch-then-poll-or-piggyback compose into a non-blocking, lossless job pattern?
positions.why: Both expressions describe the same ratified async job contract for remember from the same technical register and decision-level conviction: src-1 ratifies the contract's load-bearing rules (receipt in seconds, polling cursor, no blocking call, no lost work), and src-2 restates its control-flow maxim (dispatch, then poll or piggyback). The shared directional read is the contract's operational shape — how dispatch, receipt, and polling compose — stated as settled present fact in native pipeline vocabulary. A mild tension sits in the relational footing: src-1 enacts communal ratification ('We ratified') while src-2 frames a hierarchical dispatch authority ('remember dispatches, then the agent polls'), but both hold under the same contract-design read.
